Early adopter · 28 Sep 2026
ZAZISE · South Africa
help.lede: A short guide to what ZAZISE is, why this preview exists, and how to try the current build, with warmth, clarity, and a little South African soul.
help.s1_h2: Born from love of South Africa
help.s1_p1: ZAZISE grew out of a simple conviction: South Africa deserves a video space that sounds like home, not a copy of somewhere else. We want a place where creators, storytellers, and everyday voices can Make Yourself Known in the languages we actually speak.
help.s1_p2: That means designing for up to 12 South African languages (including South African Sign Language as a prominent presence in the UI), celebrating local craft, and building with respect for the people who will use it. ZAZISE carries that voice: premium, minimal, warm, with craft over noise.
help.note_body: This early adopter initiative invites South Africans (and friends of SA) to register interest, poke at the preview, and help shape what ships. Contributors who put time, feedback, or craft into the journey are acknowledged with gratitude. You are part of the story, not just the audience.
help.s2_p1: This is an early adopter preview, not the finished product or a full production launch. It exists so you can feel the flow: register, then thank you, then Early Adopter Preview home.
help.s3_h2: The current build: what to try
help.f1_d: First name, surname, email, password (with confirm), and reCAPTCHA.
help.f2_d: You are on the list. Early adopter confirmation includes a clear path into the preview.
help.f3_d: Trend and video cards come alive on hover, a taste of SA motion and mood.
help.f4_d: Several colour options and hover accents (gold / blue / green) bring craft, not chrome.
help.f5_d: “We’re still cooking. Be patient.” Friendly toasts when preview CTAs are not live yet.
help.f6_d: Tap the ZAZISE mark from the preview to head back to registration.
help.card_p: After you register with a first name and surname, the preview avatar shows initials derived from those two fields (e.g. Thabo Nkosi → TN). Initials are kept in browser storage for the preview. See the Privacy note.
help.step1: Open https://zazise.africa/register.html (or run the local demo with npm start in the wireframes folder).
help.step2: Create an early adopter account: first name, surname, email, password, confirm, and reCAPTCHA.
help.step3: After success you land on the thank you screen, then open Early Adopter Preview to explore the home experience.
help.step4: Hover cards, try Top Trending colours, click around. Cooking toasts gently remind you that some paths are still simmering.
help.s5_p1: You are not “just testing software.” You are helping decide what a SA first video space should feel like. Share what delights you, what confuses you, and what you’d want your community to see first. We listen.
help.s5_li1: Register once with a real email you’re happy to hear from later.
help.s5_li2: Use the language bar: EN, AF, ZU, XH, ST, and more, then tell us what reads true.
help.s5_li3: Treat the preview as a conversation starter, not a finished product.
help.s6_p1: Start with these Help pages, or reach out through the channel your invite came from. Keep feedback kind and concrete. That’s how craft gets better.

privacy.meta_sub:
Early adopter · 28 Sep 2026
ZAZISE · South Africa
privacy.lede: How we handle personal information in this ZAZISE early adopter preview. It is clear, proportionate, and written for South Africans.
privacy.s1_p1: For this preview, “we” means ZAZISE (South Africa) operating the early adopter registration flow and preview. Contact for privacy questions should go through the channel by which you were invited, or the project maintainers named in that invite.
privacy.s2_p1: When you register as an early adopter, we may collect:
privacy.s2_li4: Password, stored only as a hashed value (never shown as plaintext in notices, operator logs, or emails)
privacy.s2_p2: We also use a human verification step (reCAPTCHA / similar) so bots don’t flood the list. That provider may process technical signals under its own terms.
privacy.card_p: We do not sell your personal information. Early adopter data exists to run this preview and to notify you about ZAZISE, not to trade.
privacy.s3_li1: To maintain an early adopter list of people who registered interest.
privacy.s3_li2: To notify you about preview progress, invites, or next steps (where an email was provided).
privacy.s3_li3: To operate the registration and account shape in this build.
privacy.s3_li4: To show preview personalisation such as profile initials on the Early Adopter Preview home.
privacy.s4_p1: This build stores registration records on the host running the preview (for example a JSON store). It is not a full production cloud launch. Treat the host’s access controls as the primary safeguard for this stage.
privacy.s4_p2: Passwords are retained only in hashed form. Plaintext passwords are not written into notices for operators.
privacy.s5_p1: The Early Adopter Preview may keep a small profile object (e.g. first name, surname, and derived initials) in browser localStorage / sessionStorage so the avatar can greet you without a full production auth stack. Language preference may also be stored locally (e.g. zazise.lang).
privacy.s5_p2: You can clear this data by clearing site data for this origin in your browser.
privacy.s6_p1: We keep early adopter records for as long as they are useful to the initiative (notify / acknowledge / shape the product), or until you ask us to remove your details where practically possible on the host. When this preview is retired, local stores should be wiped or archived only as needed for the project’s internal lessons, not for secondary marketing unrelated to ZAZISE.
privacy.s7_p1: We do not sell personal data. Limited technical sharing may occur with verification providers (e.g. reCAPTCHA) solely to run abuse prevention. Contributors acknowledged in project materials are named with care; your registration email is not published as a “contributor list” by default.
privacy.s8_li1: Use a contact email you’re comfortable receiving project updates on.
privacy.s8_li2: Ask (via your invite channel) to be removed from the early adopter list where the host can action it.
privacy.s8_li3: Clear browser storage to remove local preview initials and language prefs.
privacy.s9_p1: We aim to handle personal information in a way that respects the spirit of South Africa’s Protection of Personal Information Act (POPIA): collect only what we need for the early adopter purpose, keep it secure for this context, be transparent, and avoid secondary use that would surprise you. This paragraph gives a broad overview of our approach.
privacy.s10_p1: Privacy questions about this preview: use the same channel that invited you into the early adopter programme, addressed to ZAZISE (South Africa).

terms.lede: Basic terms for participating in the ZAZISE early adopter / public participation preview. Separate from Privacy. Warm but clear, with craft over legalese.
terms.s1_p1: ZAZISE early adopter materials, including registration, thank you, and the Early Adopter Preview home, are provided as a preview. Features may be incomplete, change without notice, or show “we’re still cooking” toasts where live behaviour is not yet available. Nothing here guarantees a launch date, feature set, or ongoing service level.
terms.s2_p1: By joining, you take part in a public participation initiative born from love of South Africa and the need for a video space that speaks to SA (including a UI for several languages and the spirit of Make Yourself Known). Feedback you share may inform product direction. Unless we agree otherwise in writing, feedback is voluntary and not confidential.
terms.s3_li1: Abuse, disrupt, or overload the preview (including automated registration / scraping beyond fair testing).
terms.s3_li2: Attempt to bypass human verification, probe other users’ data, or compromise the host.
terms.s3_li3: Upload or transmit unlawful, harmful, hateful, or infringing content through any path that becomes available.
terms.s3_li4: Misrepresent your identity in a way intended to deceive other participants or operators.
terms.s3_li5: Use the preview for commercial spam, malware distribution, or any illegal purpose under South African law.
terms.s3_p2: We may suspend or remove access if acceptable use is breached.
terms.s4_p1: If you create an early adopter account (name, surname, email, password, reCAPTCHA), you are responsible for keeping your credentials confidential and for activity under your account on the host. Use an email you control. Do not share passwords.
terms.s5_p1: ZAZISE, the colour lockup / header marks, sample media, UI craft, and related branding remain the property of their respective owners. Early access does not grant you a licence to copy, rebrand, or commercially exploit ZAZISE marks outside ordinary personal preview use and good faith sharing of the initiative’s story (with attribution).
terms.s6_p1: People who contribute craft, feedback, or time to this early adopter journey may be acknowledged with gratitude in project materials. Acknowledgement is recognition, not employment, partnership, or equity unless a separate written agreement says otherwise.
terms.s7_p1: The preview is provided “as is” and “as available.” To the fullest extent permitted by applicable law, we disclaim warranties of merchantability, fitness for a particular purpose, uninterrupted availability, and operation without errors. Preview GIFs, trending UI, toasts, and local storage behaviours are illustrative.
terms.s8_p1: To the fullest extent permitted by applicable law, ZAZISE and operators of this preview are not liable for indirect, incidental, special, consequential, or exemplary damages arising from your use of (or inability to use) the preview, including lost data, missed notifications, or decisions you make based on preview content. Where liability cannot be excluded, it is limited to the greater of ZAR 0 (preview is free) or the minimum amount that cannot be excluded required by law.
terms.s8_p2: Nothing in these Terms excludes liability that South African law does not allow to be excluded (for example, certain rights under consumer protection statutes where they apply).
terms.s9_p1: We may update these preview Terms as the early adopter initiative evolves. The date on this document (28 September 2026) indicates the version you were shown. Continued use of a refreshed build after notice constitutes acceptance of the revised terms where permitted.
terms.s10_p1: These Terms are intended to be read under the laws of South Africa, without a full jurisdictional review. Courts of South Africa are the intended venue for disputes that cannot be resolved amicably. This is a high level summary for the demonstration.
terms.s11_p1: Privacy practices are described separately in Privacy. Help and how to guidance lives in Help. Each document stands on its own.

help.lede: ’n Kort gids tot wat ZAZISE is, hoekom hierdie voorskou bestaan, en hoe om die huidige bou te probeer — met warmte, helderheid en ’n bietjie Suid-Afrikaanse siel.
help.s1_p1: ZAZISE het gegroei uit ’n eenvoudige oortuiging: Suid-Afrika verdien ’n videoruimte wat soos tuis klink, nie ’n kopie van iewers anders nie. Ons wil ’n plek hê waar skeppers, storievertellers en alledaagse stemme hulself bekend kan maak in die tale wat ons werklik praat.
help.s1_p2: Dit beteken ontwerp vir tot 12 Suid-Afrikaanse tale (insluitend Suid-Afrikaanse Gebaretaal as ’n prominente teenwoordigheid in die UI), viering van plaaslike vakmanskap, en bou met respek vir die mense wat dit sal gebruik.
help.note_body: Hierdie vroeë aannemer inisiatief nooi Suid-Afrikaners (en vriende van SA) om belangstelling te registreer, die voorskou te toets, en te help vorm wat verskyn. Bydraers word met dankbaarheid erken.
help.s2_p1: Dit is ’n vroeë aannemer voorskou, nie die finale produk of ’n volle produksie bekendstelling nie. Dit bestaan sodat jy die vloei kan voel: registreer, dankie, dan Early Adopter Preview tuis.
help.s3_h2: Die huidige bou: wat om te probeer
help.f1_d: Voornaam, van, e-pos, wagwoord (met bevestiging), en reCAPTCHA.
help.f2_d: Jy is op die lys. Bevestiging sluit ’n pad na die voorskou in.
help.f3_d: Neiging- en videokaarte lewe op sweef — SA beweging en stemming.
help.f4_d: Verskeie kleuropsies en sweefaksente (goud / blou / groen).
help.f5_d: “Ons kook nog. Wees geduldig.” Vriendelike tosties wanneer CTAs nog nie leef nie.
help.f6_d: Tik die ZAZISE merk vanaf die voorskou om terug te gaan na registrasie.
help.card_p: Ná registrasie met voornaam en van wys die voorskou avatar voorletters (bv. Thabo Nkosi → TN). Sien die Privaatheid nota.
help.step1: Maak https://zazise.africa/register.html oop (of hardloop die plaaslike demo met npm start).
help.step2: Skep ’n vroeë aannemer rekening: voornaam, van, e-pos, wagwoord, bevestig, en reCAPTCHA.
help.step3: Na sukses kom jy by die dankie skerm, maak dan Early Adopter Preview oop.
help.step4: Sweef kaarte, probeer Top Neigings kleure, klik rond. Kooktosties herinner jou dat sommige paaie nog prut.
help.s5_p1: Jy “toets nie net sagteware” nie. Jy help besluit hoe ’n SA eerste videoruimte moet voel. Deel wat jou bly maak, wat verwar, en wat jy eerste wil sien. Ons luister.
help.s5_li1: Registreer een keer met ’n e-pos waarmee jy later kontak wil hê.
help.s5_li2: Gebruik die taalbalk: EN, AF, ZU, XH, ST, en meer — sê vir ons wat eg lees.
help.s5_li3: Behandel die voorskou as ’n gesprekbeginner, nie ’n klaar produk nie.
help.s6_p1: Begin by hierdie Hulp bladsye, of bereik uit via die kanaal waaruit jou uitnodiging gekom het. Hou terugvoer vriendelik en konkreet.

privacy.lede: Hoe ons persoonlike inligting in hierdie ZAZISE vroeë aannemer voorskou hanteer. Duidelik, proporsioneel, en vir Suid-Afrikaners geskryf.
privacy.s1_p1: Vir hierdie voorskou beteken “ons” ZAZISE (Suid-Afrika) wat die vroeë aannemer registrasiestroom bedryf. Privaatheidsvrae gaan deur die kanaal waardeur jy genooi is.
privacy.s2_p1: Wanneer jy as vroeë aannemer registreer, mag ons versamel:
privacy.s2_li4: Wagwoord, slegs as ’n gehashte waarde gestoor (nooit as plaintext in kennisgewings of e-posse)
privacy.s2_p2: Ons gebruik ook mensverifikasie (reCAPTCHA / soortgelyk) sodat bots nie die lys oorstroom nie.
privacy.card_p: Ons verkoop nie jou persoonlike inligting nie. Vroeë aannemer data bestaan om hierdie voorskou te bedryf en jou oor ZAZISE in kennis te stel.
privacy.s3_li1: Om ’n vroeë aannemer lys te hou van mense wat belangstelling geregistreer het.
privacy.s3_li2: Om jou te verwittig oor voorskou vordering, uitnodigings, of volgende stappe.
privacy.s3_li3: Om registrasie en rekeningvorm in hierdie bou te bedryf.
privacy.s3_li4: Om voorskou verpersoonliking soos profiel voorletters te wys.
privacy.s4_p1: Hierdie bou stoor registrasie rekords op die gasheer wat die voorskou bedryf (bv. ’n JSON winkel). Dit is nie ’n volle produksie wolk bekendstelling nie.
privacy.s4_p2: Wagwoorde word slegs in gehashte vorm gehou.
privacy.s5_p1: Die Early Adopter Preview mag ’n klein profiel objek (voornaam, van, voorletters) in blaaier localStorage / sessionStorage hou. Taalvoorkeur mag ook plaaslik gestoor word (zazise.lang).
privacy.s5_p2: Jy kan hierdie data skoonmaak deur werfdata vir hierdie oorsprong in jou blaaier te skoon.
privacy.s6_p1: Ons hou vroeë aannemer rekords solank hulle nuttig is vir die inisiatief, of totdat jy vra dat ons jou besonderhede verwyder waar prakties moontlik.
privacy.s7_p1: Ons verkoop nie persoonlike data nie. Beperkte tegniese deling mag plaasvind met verifikasieverskaffers (bv. reCAPTCHA) slegs vir misbruikvoorkoming.
privacy.s8_li1: Gebruik ’n kontak e-pos waarmee jy gemaklik is om projekopdaterings te ontvang.
privacy.s8_li2: Vra (via jou uitnodigingskanaal) om van die lys verwyder te word waar die gasheer dit kan doen.
privacy.s8_li3: Skoon blaaierberging om plaaslike voorletters en taalvoorkeure te verwyder.
privacy.s9_p1: Ons mik om persoonlike inligting te hanteer op ’n wyse wat die gees van Suid-Afrika se Wet op die Beskerming van Persoonlike Inligting (POPIA) respekteer: versamel slegs wat nodig is, hou dit veilig, wees deursigtig.
privacy.s10_p1: Privaatheidsvrae: gebruik dieselfde kanaal wat jou genooi het, gerig aan ZAZISE (Suid-Afrika).

terms.lede: Basiese bepalings vir deelname aan die ZAZISE vroeë aannemer / openbare deelname voorskou. Aparte van Privaatheid.
terms.s1_p1: ZAZISE vroeë aannemer materiale, insluitend registrasie, dankie, en die Early Adopter Preview, word as ’n voorskou verskaf. Kenmerke mag onvolledig wees of verander sonder kennisgewing.
terms.s2_p1: Deur aan te sluit neem jy deel aan ’n openbare deelname inisiatief gebore uit liefde vir Suid-Afrika. Terugvoer mag produkrichting inlig. Tensy anders ooreengekom, is terugvoer vrywillig en nie vertroulik nie.
terms.s3_li1: Die voorskou te misbruik, te ontwrig, of te oorlaai.
terms.s3_li2: Mensverifikasie te omseil, ander gebruikers se data te peil, of die gasheer te kompromitteer.
terms.s3_li3: Onwettige, skadelike, haatlike, of inbreukmakende inhoud op te laai of te stuur.
terms.s3_li4: Jou identiteit verkeerd voor te stel om ander te mislei.
terms.s3_li5: Die voorskou te gebruik vir kommersiële strooipos, wanware, of enige onwettige doel onder Suid-Afrikaanse reg.
terms.s3_p2: Ons mag toegang opskort of verwyder as aanvaarbare gebruik oortree word.
terms.s4_p1: As jy ’n vroeë aannemer rekening skep, is jy verantwoordelik om jou besonderhede vertroulik te hou. Gebruik ’n e-pos wat jy beheer. Moenie wagwoorde deel nie.
terms.s5_p1: ZAZISE, die kleur slot / kopmerke, monster media, UI vakmanskap, en verwante handelsmerke bly die eiendom van hul onderskeie eienaars. Vroeë toegang gee nie ’n lisensie om ZAZISE merke kommersieel te eksploiteer nie.
terms.s6_p1: Mense wat vakmanskap, terugvoer, of tyd bydra mag met dankbaarheid erken word. Erkenning is nie indiensneming, vennootskap, of ekwiteit nie tensy ’n aparte skriftelike ooreenkoms anders sê.
terms.s7_p1: Die voorskou word “soos dit is” en “soos beskikbaar” verskaf. Tot die volle mate wat die wet toelaat, wys ons waarborge van verhandelbaarheid, geskiktheid, en ononderbroke beskikbaarheid van die hand.
terms.s8_p1: Tot die volle mate wat die wet toelaat, is ZAZISE en operateurs nie aanspreeklik vir indirekte, toevallige, spesiale, of gevolglike skade voortvloeiend uit jou gebruik van die voorskou nie.
terms.s8_p2: Niks in hierdie Bepalings sluit aanspreeklikheid uit wat Suid-Afrikaanse reg nie toelaat om uitgesluit te word nie.
terms.s9_p1: Ons mag hierdie voorskou Bepalings bywerk soos die inisiatief ontwikkel. Die datum (28 September 2026) dui die weergawe aan wat jy gesien het.
terms.s10_p1: Hierdie Bepalings word onder die wette van Suid-Afrika gelees. Howe van Suid-Afrika is die beoogde forum vir geskille.
terms.s11_p1: Privaatheidspraktyke word apart in Privaatheid beskryf. Hulp lewe in Hulp. Elke dokument staan op sy eie.

help.lede: Umhlahlandlela omfushane wokuthi iyini i-ZAZISE, kungani lokhu kubukwa kukhona, nokuthi ungayizama kanjani — ngokufudumele, ngokucacile, nangomphefumulo waseNingizimu Afrika.
help.s1_p1: I-ZAZISE ikhule esikhungweni esilula: iNingizimu Afrika ifanele indawo yevidiyo ezwakala njengekhaya. Sifuna indawo lapho abadali, abaxoxi bezindaba, namazwi ansuku zonke bengazenza aziwe ngezilimi esikhuluma ngazo ngempela.
help.s1_p2: Lokho kusho ukuklama kuze kufike ezilimini eziyi-12 zaseNingizimu Afrika (kuhlanganise noLimi Lwezandla lwaseNingizimu Afrika), ukugubha ubuciko bendawo, nokwakha ngenhlonipho.
help.note_body: Lolu hlelo lwabaqalisi lumema abantu baseNingizimu Afrika ukuba babhalise intshisekelo, bahlolisise ukubuka kuqala, futhi basize ukubumba okuzothunyelwa.
help.s2_p1: Lokhu kuwukubuka kuqala kwabaqalisi, hhayi umkhiqizo ophelele. Kukhona ukuze uzwe ukuhamba: bhalisa, bese uyabonga, bese i-Early Adopter Preview.
help.f2_d: Usesohlwini. Ukuqinisekisa kuhlanganisa indlela eya ekubukeni kuqala.
help.f3_d: Amakhadi athrenda namavidiyo aphila uma undiza ngaphezulu.
help.f4_d: Izinketho zemibala nezichasiso zokundiza (golide / luhlaza / green).
help.f5_d: “Sisapheka. Yiba nesineke.” Amathosti anomusa uma ama-CTA engakaphili.
help.f6_d: Thepha uphawu lwe-ZAZISE ukuze ubuyele ekubhaliseni.
help.card_p: Ngemva kokubhalisa ngegama nesibongo, i-avatar ikhombisa amagama okuqala (isb. Thabo Nkosi → TN). Bona inothi yePrivacy.
help.step1: Vula https://zazise.africa/register.html (noma sebenzisa i-demo yendawo nge-npm start).
help.step2: Dala i-akhawunti yomqalisi: igama, isibongo, i-imeyili, iphasiwedi, qinisekisa, ne-reCAPTCHA.
help.step3: Ngemva kwempumelelo ufika esikrinini sokubonga, bese uvula i-Early Adopter Preview.
help.step4: Ndiza amakhadi, zama imibala ye-Top Trending, chofoza. Amathosti okupheka akukhumbuza ukuthi ezinye izindlela zisapheka.
help.s5_p1: Awuvele “uhlola isofthiwe.” Usiza ukunquma ukuthi indawo yevidiyo yokuqala ye-SA kufanele izizwe kanjani. Siyalalela.
help.s5_li1: Bhalisa kanye nge-imeyili yangempela ojabulile ukuzwa kuyo kamuva.
help.s5_li2: Sebenzisa ibha yolimi: EN, AF, ZU, XH, ST, nokunye — sitshele okufunda kuyiqiniso.
help.s5_li3: Phatha ukubuka kuqala njengesiqalo sengxoxo, hhayi umkhiqizo oqediwe.
help.s6_p1: Qala ngalawa amakhasi oSizo, noma uxhumane ngesiteshi isimemo sakho esivela kuso. Gcina impendulo inomusa necacile.

privacy.lede: Indlela esiphatha ngayo ulwazi lomuntu siqu kulokhu kubuka kuqala kwe-ZAZISE. Kucacile, kulinganiselwe, kubhalelwe abantu baseNingizimu Afrika.
privacy.s1_p1: Kulokhu kubuka kuqala, “thina” kusho i-ZAZISE (iNingizimu Afrika). Imibuzo yobumfihlo kufanele iye ngesiteshi owamenywa ngaso.
privacy.s2_p2: Siphinde sisebenzise isinyathelo sokuqinisekisa umuntu (reCAPTCHA) ukuze amarobhothi angagcwali uhlu.
privacy.card_p: Asithengisi ulwazi lwakho lomuntu siqu. Idatha yabaqalisi ikhona ukuze kuqhutshwe lokhu kubuka kuqala nokukwazisa nge-ZAZISE.
privacy.s3_li2: Ukukwazisa ngenqubekelaphambili, izimemo, noma izinyathelo ezilandelayo.
privacy.s3_li4: Ukukhombisa amagama okuqala ephrofayela ekubukeni kuqala.
privacy.s4_p1: Lesi sakhiwo sigcina amarekhodi okubhalisa kumsingathi osebenzisa ukubuka kuqala (isb. isitolo se-JSON).
privacy.s5_p1: I-Early Adopter Preview ingagcina into encane yephrofayela kubhrawuza localStorage / sessionStorage. Ukukhetha ulimi kungagcinwa (zazise.lang).
privacy.s5_p2: Ungasula le datha ngokusula idatha yesayithi kulesi sizinda.
privacy.s6_p1: Sigcina amarekhodi abaqalisi isikhathi eside njengoba ewusizo ohlelweni, noma uze usicele ukususa imininingwane yakho.
privacy.s7_p1: Asithengisi idatha yomuntu siqu. Ukwabelana okuncane kwezobuchwepheshe kungase kwenzeke nabahlinzeki bokuqinisekisa (reCAPTCHA).
privacy.s8_li1: Sebenzisa i-imeyili oyakhululekile ukuthola izibuyekezo zephrojekthi.
privacy.s8_li2: Cela (ngesiteshi sakho) ukuthi ususwe ohlwini lapho kungenzeka.
privacy.s8_li3: Sula isitoreji sebhrawuza ukususa amagama okuqala nezintandokazi zolimi.
privacy.s9_p1: Sihlose ukuphatha ulwazi lomuntu siqu ngendlela ehlonipha umoya we-POPIA: qoqa kuphela okudingekayo, kugcine kuphephile, ube sobala.
privacy.s10_p1: Imibuzo yobumfihlo: sebenzisa isiteshi esakumemayo, sibhekiswe ku-ZAZISE (iNingizimu Afrika).

terms.lede: Imigomo eyisisekelo yokubamba iqhaza ekubukeni kuqala kwe-ZAZISE. Kuhlukanisiwe nobumfihlo.
terms.s1_p1: Izinto zabaqalisi ze-ZAZISE zinikezwa njengokubuka kuqala. Izici zingase zingaphelele noma zishintshe ngaphandle kwesaziso.
terms.s2_p1: Ngokujoyina, ubamba iqhaza ohlelweni lomphakathi oluzalwa uthando lweNingizimu Afrika. Impendulo ingase ilolonge umkhiqizo. Ngaphandle kokuqiniswa, impendulo iyokuzithandela futhi ayiyimfihlo.
terms.s3_li1: Ukuhlukumeza, ukuphazamisa, noma ukulayisha kakhulu ukubuka kuqala.
terms.s3_li2: Ukuzama ukudlula ukuqinisekiswa komuntu noma ukuhlasela umsingathi.
terms.s3_li3: Ukulayisha okuvela okungekho emthethweni noma okulimazayo.
terms.s3_li5: Ukusebenzisa ukubuka kuqala ngenhloso yespamu noma ephambene nomthetho.
terms.s3_p2: Singase simise noma sisuse ukufinyelela uma ukusetshenziswa kwephulwa.
terms.s4_p1: Uma udala i-akhawunti, unesibopho sokugcina imininingwane yakho iyimfihlo. Sebenzisa i-imeyili oyilawulayo.
terms.s5_p1: I-ZAZISE, uphawu lombala, nemidiya yamashadi ihlala iyimpahla yabanikazi bayo. Ukufinyelela kwangaphambi akukuniki ilayisensi yokuxhaphaza ngokwezentengiselwano.
terms.s6_p1: Abantu abanikela ngobuciko noma impendulo bangase bakhonjiswe ngokubonga. Ukwazisa akuwona umsebenzi noma ubuhlakani ngaphandle kwesivumelwano esibhaliwe.
terms.s7_p1: Ukubuka kuqala kunikezwa “njengoba kunjalo” futhi “njengoba kutholakala.” Siphepha iziqinisekiso zokuthengiseka nokutholakala okungaphazamiseki.
terms.s8_p1: Kuze kufike ebangeni elivunyelwe umthetho, i-ZAZISE ayinakuba nesibopho somonakalo ongasuqondile ovela ekusebenziseni ukubuka kuqala.
terms.s8_p2: Lutho kulawa migomo olukhipha isibopho umthetho waseNingizimu Afrika ongavumeli ukuthi sikhishwe.
terms.s9_p1: Singase sibuyekeze le Migomo njengoba uhlelo lukhula. Usuku (28 September 2026) lukhombisa inguqulo oyibonile.
terms.s10_p1: Le Migomo ifundwa ngaphansi kwemithetho yaseNingizimu Afrika. Izinkantolo zaseNingizimu Afrika ziyindawo ehlosiwe yezingxabano.
terms.s11_p1: Ubumfihlo buchazwe ngokuhlukile kuPrivacy. Usizo luhlala kuHelp. Umbhalo ngamunye umile odwa.

help.lede: Isikhokelo esifutshane sokuba yintoni iZAZISE, kutheni lo mboniso ukho, kunye nendlela yokuzama — ngobushushu, ngokucacileyo, nangomphefumlo waseMzantsi Afrika.
help.s1_p1: IZazISE ikhule kwinkolelo elula: uMzantsi Afrika ufanele indawo yevidiyo evakala njengekhaya. Sifuna indawo apho abenzi, abaxeli bambali, namazwi emihla ngemihla banokuzazisa ngeelwimi esizithethayo ngokwenene.
help.s1_p2: Oko kuthetha ukuyila ukuya kwiilwimi ezili-12 zaseMzantsi Afrika (kuquka uLwimi Lwezandla lwaseMzantsi Afrika), ukubhiyozela ubugcisa bendawo, nokwakha ngenhlonipho.
help.note_body: Olu nkqubo lwabaqalisi lumema abantu baseMzantsi Afrika ukuba babhalise umdla, baphonononge umboniso, kwaye bancede ukubumba oko kuya kuthunyelwa.
help.s2_p1: Oku ngumboniso wabaqalisi, hayi imveliso egqibeleleyo. Ikho ukuze uzive ukuhamba: bhalisa, enkosi, emva koko iEarly Adopter Preview.
help.f1_d: Igama, ifani, iimeyile, iphasiwedi (nokuqinisekisa), kunye nereCAPTCHA.
help.f2_d: Ukuluhlu. Ukuqinisekisa kuquka indlela eya kumboniso.
help.f3_d: Amakhadi atrend kunye neevidiyo aphila xa undiza ngaphezulu.
help.f4_d: Iinketho zemibala kunye neziqaqambiso zokundiza (golide / blue / green).
help.f5_d: “Sisapheka. Yiba nomonde.” Iitosti ezinobubele xa iiCTA zingekaphili.
help.f6_d: Cofa uphawu lweZAZISE ukuze ubuyele kubhaliso.
help.card_p: Emva kokubhalisa ngegama nefani, iavatar ibonisa oonobumba bokuqala (umz. Thabo Nkosi → TN).
help.step1: Vula https://zazise.africa/register.html (okanye sebenzisa idemo yendawo nge npm start).
help.step2: Yenza iakhawunti yomqalisi: igama, ifani, iimeyile, iphasiwedi, qinisekisa, nereCAPTCHA.
help.step3: Emva kwempumelelo ufika kwisikrini senkosi, emva koko vula iEarly Adopter Preview.
help.step4: Ndiza amakhadi, zama imibala yeTop Trending. Iitosti zokupheka zikukhumbuza ukuba ezinye iindlela zisabila.
help.s5_p1: Awuvele “uvavanya isoftware.” Unceda ukugqiba indlela indawo yevidiyo yokuqala yeSA ifanele ivakalelwe ngayo. Siyamamela.
help.s5_li1: Bhalisa kanye ngeimeyile yokwenyani onokuthanda ukuva kuyo kamva.
help.s5_li2: Sebenzisa ibha yolwimi: EN, AF, ZU, XH, ST, nangaphezulu.
help.s5_li3: Phatha umboniso njengesiqalo sengxoxo, hayi imveliso egqityiweyo.
help.s6_p1: Qala ngala maphepha oNcedo, okanye uqhagamshelane ngesitishi isimemo sakho esivela kuso.

privacy.lede: Indlela esiphatha ngayo ulwazi lomntu siqu kulo mboniso weZAZISE. Kucacile, kulinganiselwe, kubhalelwe abantu baseMzantsi Afrika.
privacy.s1_p1: Kulo mboniso, “thina” kuthetha iZAZISE (uMzantsi Afrika). Imibuzo yobumfihlo mayiye ngesitishi owamenywa ngaso.
privacy.s2_p2: Sikwasebenzisa inyathelo lokuqinisekisa umntu (reCAPTCHA) ukuze iirobhothi zingagcwalisi uluhlu.
privacy.card_p: Asithengisi ulwazi lwakho lomntu siqu. Idatha yabaqalisi ikho ukuze kuqhutywe lo mboniso nokwazisa ngeZAZISE.
privacy.s3_li2: Ukukwazisa ngenkqubela, izimemo, okanye amanyathelo alandelayo.
privacy.s4_p1: Olu lwakhiwo lugcina iirekhodi zobhaliso kumsingathi osebenzisa umboniso (umz. ivenkile yeJSON).
privacy.s5_p1: IEarly Adopter Preview ingagcina into encinci yeprofayile kwibhrawuza localStorage. Ukukhetha ulwimi kungagcinwa (zazise.lang).
privacy.s5_p2: Ungasula le datha ngokusula idatha yesayithi.
privacy.s6_p1: Sigcina iirekhodi zabaqalisi ixesha elide njengoko ziluncedo, okanye ude usicele ukususa iinkcukacha zakho.
privacy.s7_p1: Asithengisi idatha yomntu siqu. Ukwabelana okuncinci kwezobugcisa kunokwenzeka nababoneleli bokuqinisekisa (reCAPTCHA).
privacy.s8_li1: Sebenzisa iimeyile oyakhululekileyo ukufumana uhlaziyo lweprojekthi.
privacy.s8_li3: Sula isitoreji sebhrawuza ukususa oonobumba nezintandokazi zolwimi.
privacy.s9_p1: Sijonge ukuphatha ulwazi lomntu siqu ngendlela ehlonipha umoya wePOPIA: qokelela kuphela okufunekayo, kugcine kukhuselekile, ube sobala.
privacy.s10_p1: Imibuzo yobumfihlo: sebenzisa isitishi esakumemayo, sibhekise kuZAZISE (uMzantsi Afrika).

terms.lede: Imiqathango esisiseko yokuthatha inxaxheba kumboniso wabaqalisi beZAZISE. Yahlukile kubumfihlo.
terms.s1_p1: Izinto zabaqalisi beZAZISE zinikezelwa njengomboniso. Iimpawu zisenokungagqibeleli okanye zitshintshe ngaphandle kwesaziso.
terms.s2_p1: Ngokujoyina, uthatha inxaxheba kwinkqubo yoluntu ezelwe luthando loMzantsi Afrika. Ingxelo inokulolonga imveliso. Ngaphandle kwesivumelwano, ingxelo iyokuzithandela yaye ayiyimfihlo.
terms.s3_li1: Ukuxhaphaza, ukuphazamisa, okanye ukulayisha kakhulu umboniso.
terms.s3_li2: Ukuzama ukudlula ukuqinisekiswa komntu okanye ukuhlasela umsingathi.
terms.s3_li3: Ukulayisha okuvela okungekho mthethweni okanye okulimazayo.
terms.s3_li5: Ukusebenzisa umboniso ngenjongo yespamu okanye ephambene nomthetho.
terms.s3_p2: Singamisa okanye sisuse ukufikelela xa ukusetyenziswa kophulwa.
terms.s4_p1: Ukuba wenza iakhawunti, unoxanduva lokugcina iinkcukacha zakho ziyimfihlo. Sebenzisa iimeyile oyilawulayo.
terms.s5_p1: IZAZISE, uphawu lombala, nemidiya yamashadi ihlala iyipato yabanini bayo. Ukufikelela kwangaphambili akukuniki ilayisensi yokuxhaphaza ngokorhwebo.
terms.s6_p1: Abantu abanegalelo ngezakhono okanye ingxelo banokwaziswa ngombulelo. Ukwazisa akusomsebenzi okanye ubuhlakani ngaphandle kwesivumelwano esibhaliweyo.
terms.s7_p1: Umboniso unikwa “njengoko unjalo” kunye “njengoko ufumaneka.” Siyakhaba iziqinisekiso zokuthengiseka nokufumaneka okungaphazamisekiyo.
terms.s8_p1: Kude kufike kwinqanaba elivunyelwe ngumthetho, iZAZISE ayinakuba noxanduva womonakalo ongasuqondanga ovela ekusebenziseni umboniso.
terms.s8_p2: Akukho nto kule Miqathango ikhupha uxanduva umthetho waseMzantsi Afrika ongavumeliyo ukuba lukhutshiwe.
terms.s9_p1: Singahlaziya le Miqathango njengoko inkqubo ikhula. Umhla (28 September 2026) ubonisa inguqulelo oyibonileyo.
terms.s10_p1: Le Miqathango ifundwa phantsi kwemithetho yoMzantsi Afrika. Iinkundla zoMzantsi Afrika yindawo ejongiweyo yeengxabano.
terms.s11_p1: Ubumfihlo buchazwe ngokwahlukileyo kuPrivacy. Uncedo luhlala kuHelp. Uxwebhu ngalunye lume lodwa.

help.lede: Tataiso e khutšoanyane ea hore ZAZISE ke eng, hobaneng teko ena e le teng, le hore u ka e leka joang — ka mofuthu, ka ho hlaka, le moeeng oa Afrika Borwa.
help.s1_h2: E tsoaletsoe lerato la Afrika Borwa
help.s1_p1: ZAZISE e hōlile ka tumelo e bonolo: Afrika Borwa e lokela sebaka sa video se utloahalang joaloka hae. Re batla sebaka seo baetsi, ba pheteli ba lipale, le mantsoe a letsatsi le letsatsi ba ka itsebisa ka lipuo tseo re li buang ka sebele.
help.s1_p2: Seo se bolela ho rala lipuo tse fihlang ho 12 tsa Afrika Borwa (ho kenyeletsoa Puo ea Matsoho ea Afrika Borwa), ho keteka bokhabane ba lehae, le ho aha ka tlhompho.
help.note_body: Morero ona oa baqali o mema batho ba Afrika Borwa ho ngolisa thahasello, ho leka teko, le ho thusa ho bopa se tla romelloa.
help.s2_p1: Sena ke teko ea baqali, eseng sehlahisoa se feleng. E teng hore u utloe phallo: ngolisa, kea leboha, ebe Early Adopter Preview.
help.s3_h2: Kaho ea hona joale: seo u ka se lekang
help.f1_d: Lebitso, fane, imeile, password (le netefatso), le reCAPTCHA.
help.f2_d: U lenaneng. Netefatso e kenyelletsa tsela e eang tekong.
help.f3_d: Likarete tsa trend le livideo li phela ha u fofa holimo.
help.f4_d: Likhetho tsa mebala le litlolo tsa ho fofa (khauta / blue / green).
help.f5_d: “Re ntse re pheha. Eba le mamello.” Litoasete tse mosa ha liCTA li e so phele.
help.f6_d: Tobetsa letšoao la ZAZISE ho khutlela ho ngoliso.
help.card_p: Ka mor’a ho ngolisa ka lebitso le fane, avatar e bontša litlhaku tsa pele (mohl. Thabo Nkosi → TN).
help.step1: Bula https://zazise.africa/register.html (kapa sebetsa demo ea lehae ka npm start).
help.step2: Theha ak’haonte ea moqali: lebitso, fane, imeile, password, netefatsa, le reCAPTCHA.
help.step3: Ka mor’a katleho u fihla skrineng ea kea leboha, ebe u bula Early Adopter Preview.
help.step4: Fofa likarete, leka mebala ea Top Trending. Litoasete tsa ho pheha li u hopotsa hore litsela tse ling li ntse li pheha.
help.s5_p1: Ha u “lekeng software feela.” U thusa ho etsa qeto ea hore sebaka sa video sa pele sa SA se lokela ho utloahala joang. Re mamela.
help.s5_li1: Ngolisa hang ka imeile ea ’nete eo u thabileng ho utloa ho eona hamorao.
help.s5_li2: Sebelisa bar ea puo: EN, AF, ZU, XH, ST, le tse ling.
help.s5_li3: Tšoara teko e le qalo ea moqoqo, eseng sehlahisoa se feleng.
help.s6_p1: Qala ka maqephe ana a Thuso, kapa ikopanye ka mocha oo memo ea hau e tsoang ho oona.

privacy.lede: Mokhoa oo re tšoarang ka oona tlhahisoleseding ea motho ka mong teko ena ea ZAZISE. E hlakile, e lekantsoe, e ngoletsoe batho ba Afrika Borwa.
privacy.s1_p1: Bakeng sa teko ena, “rona” ho bolela ZAZISE (Afrika Borwa). Lipotso tsa lekunutu li lokela ho ea ka mocha oo u memiloeng ka oona.
privacy.s2_p1: Ha u ngolisa e le moqali, re ka bokella:
privacy.s2_li4: Password, e bolokoa feela e le boleng bo hashed
privacy.s2_p2: Re boela re sebelisa mohato oa netefatso ea motho (reCAPTCHA) hore lirobot li se ke tsa tlala lethathamo.
privacy.card_p: Ha re reke tlhahisoleseding ea hau ea motho. Data ea baqali e teng ho tsamaisa teko ena le ho u tsebisa ka ZAZISE.
privacy.s3_li1: Ho boloka lethathamo la baqali ba ngolisitseng thahasello.
privacy.s3_li2: Ho u tsebisa ka tsoelo pele, limemo, kapa mehato e latelang.
privacy.s3_li4: Ho bontša litlhaku tsa pele tsa profil.
privacy.s4_p1: Kaho ena e boloka lirekoto tsa ngoliso ho host e tsamaisang teko (mohl. lebenkele la JSON).
privacy.s4_p2: Lipassword li bolokoa feela ka foromo e hashed.
privacy.s5_p1: Early Adopter Preview e ka boloka ntho e nyenyane ea profil ho browser localStorage. Khetho ea puo e ka bolokoa (zazise.lang).
privacy.s5_p2: U ka hlakola data ena ka ho hlakola data ea sebaka sa webosaete.
privacy.s6_p1: Re boloka lirekoto tsa baqali ha li ntse li thusa, kapa u re kope ho tlosa lintlha tsa hau.
privacy.s7_p1: Ha re reke data ea motho. Ho arolelana ho fokolang ha theknoloji ho ka etsahala le bafani ba netefatso (reCAPTCHA).
privacy.s8_li1: Sebelisa imeile eo u phutholohileng ho fumana litlaleho tsa projeke.
privacy.s8_li2: Kopa (ka mocha oa hau) hore u tlosoe lethathamong.
privacy.s8_li3: Hlakola polokelo ea browser ho tlosa litlhaku le likhetho tsa puo.
privacy.s9_p1: Re ikemiselitse ho tšoara tlhahisoleseding ea motho ka mokhoa o hlomphang moeeng oa POPIA: bokella feela se hlokahalang, e boloke e sireletsehile, e be pepenene.
privacy.s10_p1: Lipotso tsa lekunutu: sebelisa mocha o u memileng, o lebisitsoe ho ZAZISE (Afrika Borwa).

terms.badge: Phihlello ea pele · Sebopeho sa teko
terms.lede: Melao ea motheo ea ho nka karolo teko ea baqali ea ZAZISE. E arotsoe le Lekunutu.
terms.s1_h2: 1. Phihlello ea pele le sebopeho sa demo
terms.s1_p1: Lisebelisoa tsa baqali tsa ZAZISE li fanoa e le teko. Likarolo li ka se phethahale kapa li fetolehe ntle le tsebiso.
terms.s2_p1: Ka ho kenella, u nka karolo morerong oa sechaba o tsoaletsoeng lerato la Afrika Borwa. Maikutlo a ka bopa sehlahisoa. Ntle le tumellano, maikutlo a boithaopo ’me ha a makunutu.
terms.s3_li1: Ho hlekefetsa, ho sitisa, kapa ho tlatša teko ho feta tekanyo.
terms.s3_li2: Ho leka ho feta netefatso ea motho kapa ho hlola host.
terms.s3_li3: Ho kenya kapa ho romella litaba tse seng molaong kapa tse kotsi.
terms.s3_li4: Ho ipapisa ka tsela e reretsoeng ho thetsa.
terms.s3_li5: Ho sebelisa teko bakeng sa spam kapa morero o seng molaong.
terms.s3_p2: Re ka emisa kapa re tlose phihlello haeba tšebeliso e tlōloa.
terms.s4_p1: Haeba u theha ak’haonte, u na le boikarabelo ba ho boloka lintlha tsa hau e le lekunutu. Sebelisa imeile eo u e laolang.
terms.s5_p1: ZAZISE, letšoao la mebala, le media ea mohlala e sala e le thepa ea beng ba eona. Phihlello ea pele ha e u fe laesense ea ho sebelisa matšoao a ZAZISE khoebong.
terms.s6_p1: Batho ba tlatsetsang bokhabane kapa maikutlo ba ka tsebahatsoa ka teboho. Boitsebiso ha se mosebetsi kapa koporasi ntle le tumellano e ngotsoeng.
terms.s7_p1: Teko e fanoa “joaloka ha e le” le “joaloka ha e fumaneha.” Re hana litšepiso tsa ho rekisoa le ho fumaneha ho sa sitisoeng.
terms.s8_p1: Ho ea fihla moo molao o lumellang, ZAZISE ha e na boikarabelo bakeng sa tšenyo e sa tobang e tsoang tšebelisong ea teko.
terms.s8_p2: Ha ho letho Melaong ena le khaotsang boikarabelo boo molao oa Afrika Borwa o sa lumelleng hore bo khaotsoe.
terms.s9_p1: Re ka ntlafatsa Melao ena ha morero o hola. Letsatsi (28 September 2026) le bontša mofuta oo u o boneng.
terms.s10_p1: Melao ena e baloa tlas’a melao ea Afrika Borwa. Makhotla a Afrika Borwa ke sebaka se reretsoeng liqabang.
terms.s11_p1: Mekhoa ea lekunutu e hlalositsoe ka thoko ho Privacy. Thuso e lula ho Help. Tokomane ka ’ngoe e ema e le eona.
